info.name: NGINX Plus REST Stream Upstreams API
info.description: NGINX Plus REST API provides access to NGINX Plus status information, on-the-fly configuration of upstream servers and key-value pairs management for http and stream.

item.name: NGINX Return Configuration of a Server in a Stream Upstream Server Group

variable.description: (Required) The name of the upstream server group.

request.description: Returns configuration of a particular server in the stream upstream server group.

response.name:
Upstream is static (*UpstreamStatic*),
invalid server ID (*UpstreamBadServerId*)

Unknown version (*UnknownVersion*),
upstream not found (*UpstreamNotFound*),
server with ID “**id**” does not exist (*UpstreamServerNotFound*)

item.name: NGINX Modify a Server in a Stream Upstream Server Group

variable.description: (Required) The name of the upstream server group.

request.description: Modifies settings of a particular server in a stream upstream server group. Server parameters are specified in the JSON format.

response.name:
Upstream is static (*UpstreamStatic*),
invalid “**parameter**” value (*UpstreamConfFormatError*),
unknown parameter “**name**” (*UpstreamConfFormatError*),
nested object or list (*UpstreamConfFormatError*),
“*error*” while parsing (*UpstreamBadAddress*),

Server with ID “**id**” does not exist (*UpstreamServerNotFound*),
unknown version (*UnknownVersion*),
upstream not found (*UpstreamNotFound*)

item.name: NGINX Remove a Server from a Stream Upstream Server Group

variable.description: (Required) The name of the upstream server group.

request.description: Removes a server from a stream server group.

response.name:
Upstream is static (*UpstreamStatic*),
invalid server ID (*UpstreamBadServerId*),
server “**id**” not removable (*UpstreamServerImmutable*)

Server with ID “**id**” does not exist (*UpstreamServerNotFound*),
unknown version (*UnknownVersion*),
upstream not found (*UpstreamNotFound*)

item.name: NGINX Return Configuration of All Servers in a Stream Upstream Server Group

variable.description: (Required) The name of an upstream server group.

request.description: Returns configuration of each server in a particular stream upstream server group.

item.name: NGINX Add a Server to a Stream Upstream Server Group

variable.description: (Required) The name of an upstream server group.

request.description: Adds a new server to a stream upstream server group. Server parameters are specified in the JSON format.
